# Refusals

Every way the platform says no is one refusal from one closed union. The same refusal reaches git's `remote:` lines, the `myr` CLI and MCP. Every refusal carries:

- `_tag`: its name. Tags are public: one is renamed only with an alias.
- `retryable`: whether trying again can help, fixed for each refusal.
- `next`: the command to run next.
- `at` (optional): the `path` and `line` it points at.

No refusal has a message. Shape refusals accumulate, so one push hears about every one at once. Field types are given as they travel on the wire. Each reason is what the renderer says for one example of that refusal.

## Push and claim

### NotClaimed

- Retryable: yes
- Next: set when it is raised
- Fields:
  - `ask`: `string`
- Reason, for example: you hold no claim on fix-parser

### ClaimLapsed

- Retryable: yes
- Next: set when it is raised
- Fields:
  - `ask`: `string`
- Reason, for example: your claim on fix-parser lapsed

### NotVouched

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: no member of this project has vouched for you

### CapReached

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields:
  - `cap`: `number`
- Reason, for example: you already hold 3 claims, the most this project allows

### AskFull

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `ask`: `string`
- Reason, for example: someone else holds the claim on fix-parser

### NoAsk

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: this push names no open ask

### RepoBusy

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `git push`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: the repo was busy with another push

### DirectPush

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `ref`: `string`
- Reason, for example: main moves only by a landing, so refs/heads/main takes no direct push; push your answer to your claim's fork

### AskBlocked

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `ask`: `string`
  - `blockedBy`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: fix-parser waits on drop-moment to land first

### Denounced

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: this project's vouch file denounces you, so it takes no claims or proposals from you

## Shape

### OutOfScope

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `paths`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: changes paths outside the ask's territory: src/a.ts; put those files back, or flag the ask if the want needs them

### TouchedJudge

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `paths`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: changes files that decide what the checks do: src/a.ts; the checks are fixed for this ask, so put them back, or flag the ask if a check is wrong

### Weakened

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `weakening`: `{ readonly "marker": string, readonly "reason"?: string } | { readonly "after": number, readonly "before": number, readonly "ratchet": string, readonly "territory": string }`
- Reason, for example: adds it.skip, with the reason "flaky on CI"; it waits for a decider because it raises this territory's escapes

### PrivatePathInPublicTree

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `paths`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: would put held-back paths in a public tree: src/a.ts; those paths belong to a layer, so remove them from the answer

### ReachedInternals

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `from`: `string`
  - `to`: `string`
- Reason, for example: src/a.ts reaches into @datekit/format/src/internal.ts, which its module does not export; import it through that module's public exports instead

## Merge

### StaleBase

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `git pull --rebase`
- Fields:
  - `base`: `string`
  - `conflicts`: `ReadonlyArray<string>`
  - `main`: `string`
- Reason, for example: main moved to 2222222, past your base 1111111; conflicts in src/a.ts

### StaleLayer

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields:
  - `layer`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the maintainers layer moved since this answer was checked; it will be checked again

## Checks

### ChecksFailed

- Retryable: no
- Next: set when it is raised
- Fields:
  - `lane`: `string`
  - `logRef`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the test checks failed; the log is at logs/7

### HeldBackFailed

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields:
  - `area`: `string`
  - `suite`: `string`
- Reason, for example: a held-back check failed in parser, suite edge-cases

### AttemptsExhausted

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields:
  - `area`: `string`
  - `resetsAt`: `string`
- Reason, for example: no attempts left on parser until 2026-10-07T00:00:00.000Z

## Never counted against the answerer

### Flake

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields:
  - `lane`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the test checks failed, then passed on the same tree; the platform will run them again

### VerifierBlocked

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: the platform could not run the checks; it will run them again

## At ask open

### NotRedFirst

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: the ask's check must fail on main twice in the same way, by an assertion

### WeakCheck

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `weakness`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the ask's check is weak: no assertion

### IncompleteBrief

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `missing`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: the brief is missing territory

## Maintainers only

### LayerContentInPublicTree

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `paths`: `readonly [string, ...Array<string>]`
- Reason, for example: a layer's files would enter a public tree: src/a.ts

### SecretInOutput

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `item`: `string`
  - `where`: `"output" | "tree"`
- Reason, for example: the write-only value PAYMENTS_KEY appeared in the output

### UnstatedRequirement

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr check`
- Fields:
  - `area`: `string`
- Reason, for example: a held-back check in parser enforces something no public clause states

## Decision

### PostureChange

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr today`
- Fields:
  - `from`: `"open" | "openWithSealedEvidence" | "openOnSchedule" | "openCore" | "sourceAvailable"`
  - `to`: `"open" | "openWithSealedEvidence" | "openOnSchedule" | "openCore" | "sourceAvailable"`
- Reason, for example: landing would change the posture from open to openCore, which takes a decider

### NotDecider

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr status`
- Fields: none
- Reason, for example: only one of this project's deciders may do this

### DecisionClosed

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr today`
- Fields:
  - `decision`: `string`
- Reason, for example: dec-000001 was already decided, or expired to its default

## Lookup

### UnknownProject

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `project`: `string`
- Reason, for example: no project is named datekit

### UnknownAsk

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `ask`: `string`
- Reason, for example: this project has no ask named fix-parser

### UnknownCommit

- Retryable: no
- Next: `git fetch`
- Fields:
  - `sha`: `string`
- Reason, for example: this project has no commit 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222

### UnknownDecision

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr today`
- Fields:
  - `decision`: `string`
- Reason, for example: this project has no decision dec-000001

## Setup

### ProjectExists

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr asks`
- Fields:
  - `project`: `string`
- Reason, for example: a project named datekit already exists

### ImportFailed

- Retryable: yes
- Next: `myr init`
- Fields:
  - `reason`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the import failed: the repo needs a sign-in to read

## Env

### UnknownEnvItem

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr env shape`
- Fields:
  - `key`: `string`
- Reason, for example: the env shape has no item PAYMENTS_KEY

### NotSensitive

- Retryable: no
- Next: `myr env shape`
- Fields:
  - `key`: `string`
- Reason, for example: PAYMENTS_KEY is not @sensitive, so it holds no write-only value

### ValueTooShort

- Retryable: no
- Next: set when it is raised
- Fields:
  - `key`: `string`
  - `minimum`: `number`
- Reason, for example: the value for PAYMENTS_KEY is shorter than the 32 characters it needs
